id.description: Gets the unique ID for this commission schedule.

newOrRenewal.description: Gets the renewal type applied to this schedule.

accountId.description: Gets the specific account that this commission schedule applies to.

effectiveDate.description: Gets the effective date for this commission schedule.

expirationDate.description: Gets the expiration date for this commission schedule.

planTypeId.description: Gets the plan type that this commission schedule applies to.

scheduleType.description: Gets or sets the schedule type for this commission schedule.

name.description: Gets the name of this commission schedule.

carrierId.description: Gets the ID for the carrier related to this commission schedule.

description.description: Gets the description for this commission schedule.

createdById.description: Gets the ID for the user who created this commission schedule.

createdDate.description: Gets the date and time on which this commission schedule was created.

lastUpdatedById.description: Gets the date on which this commission schedule last updated by ID.

lastUpdatedDate.description: Gets the date and time on which this commission schedule was last updated.
